title: How to Read "Vague" Job Description Language
description:
Job descriptions can sometimes have a lot of vague language around qualifications and what the company is looking for in their new hire and here’s how to turn that vague language into what actually goes on your resume. “Team Player” really just means you’re great to work with so with your resume show various ways you’ve collaborated with other people on your team. #resumetips #resumeadvice #resumewriting #jobdescription #jobseeker
